messages:
Priya (infra): Heads-up: we're bringing up kraken-west1 (private + dedicated GPUs) next Tue 2026-04-12 09:00 PT. This thread is the SRE handoff: paging, runbook, ownership, and training. Please read and ack.

Sam W: Ack, what's the primary PagerDuty service and severity mapping?

Priya (infra): PD service: "SRE - kraken-west1" (team: eng-sre). Mapping: sev1=all-hands page (high), sev2=oncall primary only. See snippet below for the initial PD config that will be added to the runbook. PD IDs will be attached later.

```
pagerduty:
  service: "SRE - kraken-west1"
  routes:
    - sev1: escalation_policy: "SRE-Global"
    - sev2: escalation_policy: "SRE-Oncall"
```

Anya R: Any cost capping or autoscale limits to avoid runaway provisioning?

Priya (infra): Yes — cluster autoscaler capped at 50 nodes initially, burst disabled. Cost guard configured to send an alert when GPU-hours >= 4000 in 24h to billing-alerts. For oncall, pager rule for billing-alerts is sev3 (notify primary, escalate to infra-owners after 2h).

Jose M: GPU SKUs are H100-80GB and A100-80GB (mixed pools). Quotas: request for 120 GPUs approved. Validation steps I'll add to the runbook: run `kubectl get nodes -l accelerator` and a simple nvidia smoke check. Example smoke commands: 

```
# smoke checks
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep accelerator
kubectl describe node <node> | grep -i nvidia
ssh node && nvidia-smi -L
```

Lena (SRE lead): Who owns oncall rotation for the first 14 days?

Priya (infra): eng-sre owns week 1 (rotation id: eng-sre/kraken-week1). After 14 days we'll transition to product-platform oncall; a handoff doc + 1hr runthrough scheduled on day 10. I'll post the calendar invite.

Sam W: Paging thresholds? Node flaps, GPU errors, KV cache errors?

Priya (infra): Key pages: node NotReady -> sev1, OOM pods affecting model pipeline -> sev1, network blackholes (packet loss > 5% for > 3 mins) -> sev1. Cache hitrate degradation and latency regressions -> sev2. Synthetic checks: KV cache hitrate < 70% -> sev2 alert; tail latency P95 > 400ms on inference gateway -> sev2.

oncall-bot: deploy:kraken-bootstrap completed by priya at 2026-04-12T09:32:10Z :white_check_mark:

Anya R: Training slot for the oncall runthrough please — can we do 2026-04-13 15:00 PT? link: https://meet.example.com/kraken-handoff

Priya (infra): Scheduled. Runbook URL: https://docs.internal/redwood/kraken-west1/handoff. Please read before the session. Runbook will include: PD service IDs, escalation steps, smoke scripts, quick commands, and rollback checklist. Any objections? :thumbsup:

Sam W: +1

Jose M: +1. I'll push the smoke scripts to repo infra/kraken and add a CI job that runs the `nvidia-smi` check on boot.

Lena (SRE lead): Acked. I'll create a one-page playbook card (Confluence + PagerDuty quick links) for the oncall rotation and add it to the eng-oncall pinned channel.

Priya (infra): Thanks all — will update the runbook with PD IDs, smoke outputs, and the handoff slide before EOD. If anyone hits anything during bootstrap pls ping here and page if sev1.

Sam W: Noted.

Anya R: Thanks, Priya.

Jose M: Will monitor GPU telemetry during initial ramp.

Lena (SRE lead): Preparing runthrough checklist now.

Priya (infra): Closing loop: final checklist items for oncall to be familiar with before go-live: 1) PD responder list and escalation policy, 2) smoke script location (infra/kraken/smoke), 3) cost guard thresholds, 4) quick rollback (scale down nodepool + disable autoscaler), 5) short runthrough (2026-04-13 15:00 PT).
